verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only Teams Export APIs for exporting chat and channel messages, plus 21-day access to user-deleted messages through those APIs. That is an adjacent export capability, not a way to configure or enforce retention policies or place legal holds. Nothing in the pack describes retention policy configuration, legal hold placement, or eDiscovery hold workflows.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce message retention policies and legal holds for compliance and eDiscovery

citations.quote: Teams Export APIs allow you to export 1:1, group chat, meeting chats, and channel messages from Microsoft Teams.
